description.value: Burger Crush is a fast-casual burger chain with three BC locations, serving smashed Canadian Angus beef burgers, house-made vegan patties, tofu nuggets, and dairy or cashew-milk shakes. Founded by self-described kids of the 80s, it aims to revive the stress-free classic burger shop experience. The Vancouver location on Nelson Street offers both pickup and delivery, with indoor seating in an air-conditioned, wheelchair-accessible space.
